registration.reason: The manifest handshake returns a persistent private key and other credentials to a callback. No callback service or secret-returning automation is prepared; the Owner UI avoids introducing one.
registration.nameCollisionPolicy: use an Owner-approved account-prefixed name of at most 34 characters; record actual name and slug

credential.bootstrapStorage: Owner-controlled secure local store outside repository, Actions, logs, chat, and task artifacts; used only by separately approved trusted isolated test harness
credential.storage: Future Environment secret r3-trusted-publisher / KIRARI_R3_PUBLISHER_PRIVATE_KEY; blocked until protected trusted base and final admission are established

identityReadback.appIdSource: authenticated GET /app plus Owner App settings; App ID is not client ID or installation ID
identityReadback.installationSource: authenticated GET /repos/markd3ng/KIRARI/installation and installation repository listing
identityReadback.checkSource: GET /repos/markd3ng/KIRARI/check-runs/{check_run_id}; match app.id, app.slug, name, head_sha, external_id, status, conclusion, and timestamps
identityReadback.rulesetIntegrationIdSource: observed check_run.app.id; never GitHub Actions shared ID 15368

ownerSetupEvidenceRequired: record the actual numeric App ID without substituting a guessed value
record public App owner/name/slug, installation ID, repository selection, and permission readback; never record credentials
create the dedicated Environment with the documented main-only branch policy
create no broader repository or organization secret
first establish the reviewed implementation through a separate exact-head Owner merge or other explicit trusted-base authorization
approve the exact isolated test target and key custody before any App/installation/key/Environment creation
verify source-bound ruleset behavior with checks-write only; do not add statuses or administration permission to work around unverified UI behavior
